recognize_zh: 成群的中大型母細胞核圓、染色質細緻，多數核中央或一側有淡染的杯狀凹陷（cup-like），部分胞質可見少量細顆粒，符合伴杯狀母細胞的急性骨髓性白血病。
features: Clusters of medium to large blasts with high N:C ratio
Round to slightly indented nuclei with a pale cup-shaped invagination in many cells
Scant to moderate pale cytoplasm, some with fine azurophilic granules
Occasional smudged cell and platelets; red cells show crenation
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous blasts, some in clusters, with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios and finely dispersed chromatin. Many blasts contain a pale cup-like nuclear invagination, and a subset shows scant cytoplasm with fine granules. No Auer rods or maturing granulocytes are identified in this field. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with cup-like blast morphology, which correlates with NPM1 and FLT3-ITD mutations; molecular confirmation is required.

ddx.vs: Microgranular APL has bilobed or sliding-plate nuclei with Auer rod bundles, and PML::RARA must be excluded urgently.
Monocytic blasts have more abundant gray cytoplasm and folded nuclei, and are nonspecific esterase positive.
Lymphoblasts lack cytoplasmic granules and nuclear cups and are MPO negative with TdT and lymphoid antigen expression.
